selection: Four known real VibeRacing tasks plus two known development fixtures chosen by distinct consumer/state/compatibility contracts before any new P or H run. Development only; historical outcomes not pooled. No selection using new P failures.
acceptance: Full requested behavior through actual consumers
Preserved contracts and required original test scenarios
Necessary delivered regression tests and docs
Applicable patch independent of harness administrative directories
autonomy: Recorded separately from external full-patch acceptance; no manual intervention between workflow stages. H D0 and final separately assessed.
stopping: Stop scheduling on auth/quota refusal or unknown live execution; own deadline terminates one slot without retry. Unknown usage stays null.
cost: Equal wall deadline is not equal token budget; account provider requests, tools, usage, elapsed time for all H stages.
isolation: Author containers mount only git-free public initial snapshots and materialized runtime/dependencies. No evaluator/reference, research directories, adjacent projects, source Git history or host auth store. Host relay uses existing OpenCode OAuth.
interpretation: Same full tasks/order and original checks as v1. Post-v1 contract checks for legacy old-launcher preparation and catalog legacy 304 apply equally to both arms; originals and v1 raw grades remain preserved.
